In the weekly Database Systems lab I wrote SELECT statements with joins and grouping over a made-up student registration schema, and for the final task designed the tables for a small clinic.

Course project
Shuttle delays in the Hajj season (Systems Analysis and Design, spring 2026)
- Downloaded two months of shuttle-bus trip records as a spreadsheet from a government open data portal.
- Removed blank and repeated rows and fixed times that had been typed in two different formats.
- Summarised delays by hour and by route with pivot tables, and drew three charts showing that the worst delays come in the two hours after Isha prayer.
- Worked out the average and the median delay for each route and explained why the two differ.
- Wrote a four-page report with my recommendations and presented it to the class in ten minutes.
